name: Finance Q&A with citation checker
problem: RAG over public SEC filings where every claim is checked against its cited passage; unsupported claims get flagged.
limits: Public SEC financial facts, not personal financial records; source URL, retrieval hash and accession numbers are in data/. The SEC HTML endpoint returned 403; the documented data.sec.gov API succeeded. This is extractive RAG with character-ngram TF-IDF embeddings, not a neural financial analyst or generative LLM evaluation. Fifty template questions use distinct reported concepts; unsupported values are deliberately injected into half the answers to test checking. The checker validates concept, context, value, unit and scale against the cited structured fact; it cannot establish broader semantic claims. Retrieval accuracy and retained support are reported separately in bench.json. Examples are evidence/caught-claims.json. No investment advice or company affiliation.
next: Add human-authored questions over narrative filing passages and a separately evaluated semantic entailment checker.
